title: Can You Do a Boat Trip on Your Arrival or Departure Day in Madeira?
description: Departure day works: a 10:00 Day Trip is back by 13:00. Arrival day is a gamble, because wind delays and diversions at Madeira's airport are common enough.
heroAlt: A passenger plane low over the sea on its way to Madeira airport, seen from a boat deck
keywords: can you do a boat trip on your arrival day in madeira
boat trip on departure day madeira
last day in madeira what to do
boat trip before a flight madeira
